axiom_fee.note: 1 percent before cashback, inferred from documented net plus cashback; no unobserved rebate credited

delay.note: 250 ms delay for every submission, including every partial and final sell; NOT a certification of Axiom inclusion speed.

failed_attempts.note: Live quote drift beyond slippage produces a modeled landed failure charged base and priority; in-transaction tip and swap fees roll back. Dropped/revert-protected alternatives are reported in sensitivity, not invented as observations.

priority_tip.note: Each 0.001 SOL; not a measured fee bid required for a particular trade

pump_fee.note: SOL bonding curve total protocol and creator fee, no graduated-pool route assumed

rent.note: 200 bytes is a cost scenario, not a verified Axiom token-account layout. Refund on final close is a model assumption.

slippage.note: Quote-to-fill drift and constant-product price impact, not a made-up realized Axiom fill; 20 percent tolerance is an experimental setting.

limitations: Axiom is the documented fee reference, not an authenticated market/execution connection.
Per-arm virtual reserve overlays preserve own partial-sell impact, while holding externally observed trader reserve changes fixed; that counterfactual approximation does not prove actual execution.
Unmodeled leader admission, MEV, route failure and network drops remain unknown; a zero modeled failure count cannot establish a real zero failure rate.
Safety and cost-model changes make this a new experiment, not a continuation of the earlier low-cost paper balances.
Horizon selection on these data is exploratory; the chosen finalists require the separately requested unseen multi-day stress/forward phase.
The 2s rule is causal: it can only classify a trade by its observed net mark at the checkpoint, not by its eventual hindsight outcome.
A 2000ms exit decision still uses the campaign's modeled inclusion delay; it is not a claim of an on-chain fill exactly at 2000ms.
Shadow arms start with separate 3 SOL paper accounts; later admission divergence caused by their own bankroll/concurrency is retained as a policy consequence.
model_semantics: Fresh six-account forward A/B: the four existing top4 models are unchanged; FULL_3S_2S_LOSS_EXIT and FULL_3S_V2_2S_LOSS_EXIT use one causal 2000ms net-after-costs loss checkpoint, then retain the parent 3000ms horizon when the checkpoint is non-negative.

truth_constraints.frozen_historical_corpus_use: prior reputation features only; never counted as prospective outcomes
